host.name: Host
host.description: IP address or hostname of the GB/T 12241 device

port.name: Port
port.description: TCP port of the GB/T 12241 device

class1_timeout.name: Class 1 Data Timeout (ms)
class1_timeout.description: Timeout for class 1 data (realtime data like voltage, current). If no data is received within this time, driver will actively query.
class1_timeout.description_zh: 一类数据超时时间（如电压、电流等实时数据）。如果在此时间内未收到数据，驱动将主动查询。

class2_timeout.name: Class 2 Data Timeout (ms)
class2_timeout.description: Timeout for class 2 data (statistical data like energy). If no data is received within this time, driver will actively query.
class2_timeout.description_zh: 二类数据超时时间（如累计电量等统计数据）。如果在此时间内未收到数据，驱动将主动查询。

connection_mode.name: Connection Mode
connection_mode.description: Neuron as the client, or as the server
connection_mode.description_zh: Neuron 作为客户端或服务端

device_degrade.name: Device Degradation
device_degrade.description: Enable or disable device degradation mechanism
device_degrade.description_zh: 启用或禁用设备降级机制

degrade_cycle.name: Failure Threshold for Degradation
degrade_cycle.description: The number of consecutive failure cycles required to trigger device degradation
degrade_cycle.description_zh: 触发设备降级所需的连续失败周期数

degrade_time.name: Recovery Time After Degradation
degrade_time.description: The time in seconds after which the device recovers from degradation
degrade_time.description_zh: 设备从降级中恢复所需的时间（单位：秒）

max_retries.name: Maximum Retry Times
max_retries.description: The maximum number of retries after a failed attempt to send a read command
max_retries.description_zh: 发送读指令失败后最大重试次数

endianess.name: Endianess
endianess.description: Tag byte order, ABCD corresponds to 1234

polling_enabled.name: Enable Historical Data Polling
polling_enabled.description: Enable or disable the historical data polling feature. If enabled, the plugin will attempt to retrieve missing historical data points.
polling_enabled.description_zh: 启用或禁用历史数据召测功能。如果启用，插件将尝试检索缺失的历史数据点。

max_poll_age.name: Data Staleness Threshold (seconds)
max_poll_age.description: Time in seconds after which data is considered stale. The plugin will attempt to poll historical data for tags whose last update is older than this threshold.
max_poll_age.description_zh: 数据被视为过期的时间阈值（秒）。插件将尝试为最后更新时间早于此阈值的标签召测历史数据。

current_before_time.name: Polling End Time Offset (seconds)
current_before_time.description: Offset from the current time (in seconds) to define the end point for historical data polling. This helps avoid polling for data that might not have been fully processed or stored by the device yet. E.g., if current time is 05:00:00 and offset is 300s (5min), polling will target data up to 04:55:00.
current_before_time.description_zh: 相对于当前时间的偏移量（秒），用于定义历史数据召测的截止点。这有助于避免召测设备可能尚未完全处理或存储的数据。例如：当前时间为05:00:00，偏移量为300秒（5分钟），则召测目标数据截止到04:55:00。

polling_tags.name: Tags for Historical Polling
polling_tags.description: Specify tags for historical polling as a JSON array string. Example: [{"group": "group1", "tags": ["Ua", "Ub"]}]
polling_tags.description_zh: 以JSON数组字符串方式指定参与历史召测的标签。例如：[{"group": "group1", "tags": ["Ua", "Ub"]}]
